newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends off highs as NY disappoints.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends off highs as NY disappoints.

text.p: White sugar futures ended firmer across the board on Monday but backed off earlier highs as New York's July contract failed to maintain upside momentum, traders said.
London's August contract powered to a session high of $317.00, just 50 cents off key resistance, but then slid back as prices hit a wave of profit-taking.
"August reacted to a high of $317.00 which is quite important," said one trader, adding that traders had been waiting to see if the rally on July raws would trigger buy stops at 11.10 cents/lb.

One leading commission house was said to have been an active buyer during afternoon activity. August/October continued to widen in flat-price dealings but traders said activity was more concentrated in December/March.
August closed $3.60 higher at $316.90 and October up $2.40 at $305.40. Volume was solid at 2,254 lots, more than half of which was in August.
